shopping.title: Shopping
shopping.noLists: No shopping lists yet. Create one to get started.
shopping.addPlaceholder: Add an item, e.g. 2 L milk
shopping.empty: Nothing to buy. Add something above.

shops.label: Shops
shops.help: Shops are tabs on this list. Each tab hides the items not stocked there and the items for another shop, and puts the categories in the shop's aisle order. Ticking an item ticks it everywhere.
shops.deleteConfirm: Delete the shop "{title}"? Items stay on the list.
shops.hidden: No items are hidden | 1 item is for another shop or not stocked at {shop}, so it's hidden | {count} items are for other shops or not stocked at {shop}, so they're hidden
shops.aisleHelp: Put the categories in the order you reach them in {title}. The All tab keeps the household order.

sync.neverSynced: Not synced yet on this device.
sync.offlineHelp: No connection to the server. Changes are saved on this phone and sent when the signal returns.
sync.errorHelp: The server answered with an error. Retrying automatically.
sync.pendingHelp: No changes waiting | 1 change waiting to be sent | {count} changes waiting to be sent
sync.rejected: A change couldn't be saved and was undone | A change to {names} couldn't be saved and was undone | {count} changes to {names} couldn't be saved and were undone

conflicts.title: Conflicts
conflicts.none: No conflicts in the last 30 days.
conflicts.help: When two people change the same thing on an item at about the same time, the later change is kept.
conflicts.deleted: {name} was removed before an edit to it arrived. The edit was dropped.

recipes.empty: No recipes yet. Add one from a web page or type it in.

recipes.addToList: Add {count} to list | Add {count} to list | Add {count} to list
recipes.added: Nothing new for {list}. | Added 1 item to {list}. | Added {count} items to {list}.
recipes.foundPictures: Pictures from the page (ticked ones are saved)

recipes.reading: Reading the recipe… With the AI this can take a minute.

importedBy.schema: Imported. Check it over below, then save.
importedBy.rules: Read from the scan. Check it over below, then save.
importedBy.ai: Read by the AI. Check it over carefully, then save.

offline.tasks: Offline: showing what you last opened. Changes need signal.

error.blocked: The microphone is blocked for Mandarin. Allow it in this device's settings, or use the microphone on the keyboard instead.
error.network: Dictation needs signal. Use the microphone on the keyboard instead.
error.other: Dictation didn't work. Use the microphone on the keyboard instead.

push.title: Notifications
push.intro: Mandarin can send notifications to this phone or computer: task reminders, the daily overdue summary, and summaries of shopping list changes.

state.on: Notifications are on for this device.
state.unsupported: This browser can't receive notifications. Open Mandarin at its https address in a current browser.
state.needs-home-screen: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only reach the home-screen app. Add Mandarin to your home screen (Share → Add to Home Screen), open it from there, and come back here.
state.blocked: Notifications are blocked for Mandarin. Allow them in this device's settings (on iPhone: Settings → Notifications → Mandarin), then reload.

push.testSent: No device could be reached. | Sent to 1 device. | Sent to {count} devices.
push.reminders: Task reminders, at the time set on the task
push.overdueHint: Comes at the overdue reminder time, which is turned on and set in
push.shopping: Shopping lists: when someone else adds items to
push.shoppingHint: One notification once they've stopped adding for about 10 minutes.
push.quietHoursHint: Shopping summaries wait until the morning. Reminders still come at the time you set them.

mcp.more: More information about MCP in Mandarin

deletion.title: Delete your Mandarin Account
deletion.scheduled: We will delete your Mandarin account at {date} ({dateSince}).

export.title: Export your Mandarin data
export.description: You can request a copy of all your Mandarin data. This includes Projects, Tasks and everything associated to them. You can import this data into any Mandarin or Vikunja instance through the migration function.
export.request: Request a copy of my Mandarin Data
export.success: You've successfully requested your Mandarin Data! We will send you an email once it's ready to download.

links.explanation: Share Links allow you to easily share a project with other users who don't have an account on Mandarin.

migrate.titleService: Import your data from {name} into Mandarin
migrate.descriptionDo: Mandarin will import all lists, tasks, notes, reminders and files you have access to.
migrate.authorize: To authorize Mandarin to access your {name} Account, click the button below.
migrate.importUpload: To import data from {name} into Mandarin, click the button below to select a file.
migrate.migrationStartedWillReciveEmail: Mandarin will now import your lists/projects, tasks, notes, reminders and files from {service}. As this will take a while, we will send you an email once done. You can close this window now.

credentials.description: Enter the address of your {name} instance and how Mandarin should log in. Mandarin imports all projects and boards you have access to; the credentials are only used for this import and are not stored.

csv.columnMappingDescription: Map each column in your CSV file to a task attribute. Mandarin has auto-detected the most likely mappings. The preview below will update automatically when you change settings.

datemathHelp.intro: Specify relative dates which are resolved on the fly by Mandarin when applying the filter.

quickAddMagic.quickEntryHint: Use magic prefixes for dates, labels & more. Open the main Mandarin app and check the tooltip on the task input for more details.
quickAddMagic.label2: Mandarin will first check if the label already exist and create it if not.
